definitions.gloss: lakeside; lakeshore; shore of a lake
definitions.explanation: The area along the edge of a lake. Often associated with scenic views, resorts, and recreational activities.

examples.japanese: {湖畔|こはん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦キャンプ→キャンプ：03837_kyanpu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{湖畔|こはん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泊|と}まった→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: I stayed at a lakeside hotel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な{湖畔|こはん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧し⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: While strolling along the quiet lakeshore, I listened to the birdsong.

notes:
USAGE:
A somewhat literary word often used in travel writing and scenic descriptions. {湖畔|こはん} evokes a peaceful, natural setting and is commonly associated with vacation spots and resort areas.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {湖畔|こはん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧ (lakeside hotel)
- {湖畔|こはん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}する→散歩する：26840_sanposuru⟧ (to stroll along the lake)
- {湖畔|こはん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{建|た}つ→建つ：12544_tatsu⟧ (to stand by the lake)
- {湖畔|こはん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦キャンプ→キャンプ：03837_kyanpu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to camp by the lake)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{湖岸|こがん}→湖岸：26240_kogan⟧: lakeshore — more technical, used in geography
- ⟦{岸辺|きしべ}→岸辺：20225_kishibe⟧: shore, waterside — can refer to any body of water
- ⟦{畔|ほとり}→畔：27482_hotori⟧: beside, edge — poetic/literary term for the edge of water
